FROGS
Frogs are amphibians: they can live on land and in water. Some frogs live only on
Jand, others live only in trees and some live underground in the desert! But most
frogs live in or near water. They have long hind legs that are perfect for jumping
long distances. Their feet are webbed. All frogs have a long, sticky tongue to catch
insects. They can croak because they have vocal chords. Adult frogs can breathe in
three different ways: through their lungs, their mouth and their skin,
‘Tropical frogs of South America are brightly coloured and are poisonous. South
American Indians extract this poison and use it to make poisonous arrows,
